surprise.reaction_interpretation: FOMC Press Release was close to consensus, so cross-asset interpretation depends more on revisions, composition, and prior positioning than the headline difference alone.

transmission_chains: Near-consensus outcome -> attention shifts to revisions and composition -> yields and DXY determine whether the release changes the policy path.
Muted headline surprise -> positioning and liquidity drive the first move -> SPY, QQQ, IWM, and VIX confirmation determines whether it persists.
correlation_shifts: Gold and dollar strength are moving together, suggesting hedge demand is overriding the usual inverse relationship.
Yields and growth equities are rising together, indicating earnings or liquidity support is offsetting duration pressure.
commentary: FOMC Press Release produced a near consensus result. The interpretation is based on whether yields, DXY, gold, equity breadth, and volatility confirm the expected policy transmission rather than assuming a deterministic asset response.
